name: Exp_i-CAi_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom i-CAi_StDev indicator, which combines a smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and includes money management with multiple margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标i-CAi_StDev的交易信号进行操作，该指标结合了平滑移动平均线和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接方向判断、禁用）分别控制入场和出场，并包含多种保证金模式的资金管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于i-CAi_StDev指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。该指标使用可配置的平滑方法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX等）对价格进行平滑处理，然后叠加标准差倍数（dK1=1.5, dK2=2.5）构建通道。入场条件分为三种模式：POINT模式通过指标缓冲区3/5（买入）或2/4（卖空）的非空值点信号触发；DIRECT模式通过主线的拐点判断（买入为主线上穿、卖空为主线下穿）触发；WITHOUT模式则禁用相应方向的开仓。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可用卖卖点信号或主线下行判断，卖空平仓可用买点信号或主线上行判断。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金等多种资金管理模式（MMMode参数），并通过MM参数控制风险比例。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，提供了基本的风控框架。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following trading system based on the i-CAi_StDev indicator. This indicator applies a configurable smoothing method (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX etc.) to price data, then overlays standard deviation multiples (dK1=1.5, dK2=2.5) to construct bands. Entry conditions are split into three modes: POINT mode triggers when indicator buffers 3/5 (buy) or 2/4 (sell) show non-empty dot signals; DIRECT mode triggers on main line turning points (buy on upward crossover, sell on downward crossover); WITHOUT mode disables the corresponding direction's entries. Exit conditions similarly support three modes - buy closing can use sell dot signals or main line declining logic, while sell closing can use buy dot signals or main line rising logic. Position sizing leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions, supporting multiple money management modes including free margin-based, balance-based, and loss-adjusted margin calculations controlled by the MMMode parameter with risk ratio set via MM. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing a basic risk control framework. The EA includes a new bar check mechanism and a recount flag to avoid redundant signal calculations on the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase parameter, affects JJMA/VIDYA/AMA behavior

pros: 支持三种信号模式（点信号/方向/禁用），入场和出场可独立配置，灵活性高
采用标准差通道构建趋势判断逻辑，结合多种平滑算法，策略有一定统计学基础
内置新K线检查机制（IsNewBar），避免同一根K线重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
资金管理模式多样，支持按自由保证金、余额等多种方式计算仓位
pros_en: Supports three signal modes (point/direct/disabled) with independent entry and exit configuration, offering high flexibility
Uses standard deviation bands for trend judgment combined with multiple smoothing algorithms, providing a statistical foundation
Built-in new bar check mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents repeated entries on the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Multiple money management modes available, supporting position sizing based on free margin, balance, and other methods
cons: 默认止损1000点、止盈2000点在H4周期上偏大，可能承受较大浮亏
没有点差过滤和波动率过滤机制，在高点差或低波动环境下可能产生不利交易
依赖外部库TradeAlgorithms.mqh和SmoothAlgorithms.mqh，代码可移植性较差
信号判断中DIRECT模式的拐点检测仅用3根K线比较，容易产生假信号
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are quite large on H4 timeframe, potentially leading to significant drawdowns
No spread filter or volatility filter mechanism, which may produce unfavorable trades in high-spread or low-volatility environments
Depends on external libraries TradeAlgorithms.mqh and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, reducing code portability
The DIRECT mode turning point detection uses only 3-bar comparison, which can easily generate false signals
improvements: 增加点差过滤和ATR波动率过滤，避免在不利市场条件下开仓
加入移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势行情中锁定利润
优化DIRECT模式的拐点判断逻辑，可增加确认K线数量或结合其他指标过滤假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filter and ATR volatility filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable market conditions
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in profits during trending markets
Optimize the DIRECT mode turning point detection logic by increasing confirmation bars or adding indicator-based false signal filtering

risk_points: 止损1000点在H4周期偏大，单笔交易风险较高
无点差过滤机制，高点差品种可能导致入场滑点过大
DIRECT模式拐点判断简单，可能频繁触发假信号导致连续亏损
SignalBar=1使用已完成K线信号，但Recount机制在数据不完整时可能重复计算
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points on H4 is relatively large, creating high per-trade risk exposure
No spread filter mechanism, high-spread instruments may cause excessive slippage on entry
Simple turning point detection in DIRECT mode may frequently trigger false signals leading to consecutive losses
SignalBar=1 uses completed bar signals, but the Recount mechanism may recalculate repeatedly when data is incomplete

summary_en: This EA trades based on signals from the custom i-CAi_StDev indicator, which combines a smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and includes money management with multiple margin modes.
